## Highlights

- Stats shows your figures right away again. With an account in another currency, the screen used to stay empty until the exchange rates arrived; now only the total balance waits, with a short "Fetching exchange rates" note, and every other card is ready immediately.
- A slow or unresponsive exchange rate service no longer leaves Stats waiting forever: after a few seconds the total falls back to your Base Currency accounts and shows the usual conversion warning.
